Was mispronouncing ‘Newfoundland’ the motive for murder?

If you’re from Newfoundland, perhaps you’ve wanted to murder someone over their mangled pronunciation of the place’s name. But it really happened one Friday night in 1876. Author and cultural historian Ainsley Hawthorne tells this tale to die for.
